pair_build_audit.target_definition: log_D_A - log_D_B; A has lower atomic number; delta_Z = Z_A - Z_B < 0

protocol.model_family: antisymmetric ExtraTrees with fold-local median imputation
protocol.aggregate_r2: computed once from concatenated cross-fitted OOF predictions
protocol.shuffle_scope: only the current inner/outer training subset; test untouched

paired_group_bootstrap.method: paired held-out-group bootstrap over fixed OOF predictions; delta_macro_group_mae gives every sampled group equal weight

geometry_qc_summary.interpretation: High-vs-low geometry comparison is unavailable when the common accepted cohort contains only one QC class. Failed geometries are never admitted.
